desc: The Kapsule is easy to cut with, easy to carry, and easy on the eyes. Designed by Jens Ansø, this unique Kershaw opens with an out-the-front, manual sliding mechanism, securing the blade with a button lock. Its single-edge, spear point blade is safe and easy to use, making it an excellent box cutter. Despite its utility, the Kapsule doesn’t look like a knife at first, a perfect non-threatening carry. The slider is highlighted with blue anodizing, and the glass-filled nylon handle features unique texturing. This simple, yet effective Kershaw delivers utility in a convenient, compact package.
